title: Manager sparring — prep & reflection backlog
content:
Purpose: quick scratchpad for the next manager 1:1 + running backlog of stories, asks, and evidence I want available during calibration / promotion conversations. Use this as my single source when I need to pull 2-3 quick examples or a compact narrative.

Top-of-mind agenda (pick 3):
- career alignment: are my 6-month goals still the right stretch? (growth vs. impact balance)
- people work updates needing FYI/decisions: L3 comp calibration note, interview funnel leakage experiment, onboarding checklist pilot
- unblock asks: mentor time (2 hours/month), budget for external facilitation (Upward Feedback workshop)

Quick wins since last sync (what I can tell a story about):
1) Interview funnel experiment (Nov–Feb)
   - hypothesis: reduce time-to-offer by shortening loop 2 (take-home) -> 30% fewer drop-offs
   - result: drop-off fell from 22% -> 9% for SWE-IC roles; median TTO from 21d -> 14d
   - evidence: JIRA-OPS-211 comments + candidate NPS snippets (see linked artifacts)
   - narrative: pragmatic change, cross-functional coordination with Eng-DS, saved ~80 engineer-hours in interview scheduling

2) Onboarding pilot (private deployment cohort)
   - ran cohort 3 for Dedicated infra partners; converted checklist to interactive onboarding doc
   - early signal: new hire ramp to first commit reduced by 12 days for infra-track hires
   - anecdote: Samira (new infra SWE) shipped infra-healthcheck on day 7, calls out checklist as decisive

3) Cost-savings recommendation for internal LLM infra usage policy
   - suggested batching defaults + smart cache thresholds to product teams -> potential 6–8% monthly GPU spend reduction
   - next step: Ops to roll pilot with 2 product teams in May

Stories to surface (concise examples for calibration / promotion):
- cross-team influence: led triage that prevented a production rollout freeze by negotiating a fall-back policy with Platform Eng within 18 hours (aligned execs, wrote rollback playbook). Outcome: no customer-facing outage, saved estimate ~3 days of downtime.
- coaching: coached two ICs who were at risk of missing delivery; both improved OKR scores by end of quarter (concrete: one moved from 2 -> 3.6 on our rubric).
- initiative: proposed the candidate NPS micro-interview followup that uncovered consistent signal about take-home length (this was used to change the funnel).

Impact signals (metrics + qualitative):
- hiring funnel: TTO down 33%, take-home drop-off down 60% (see Win: Interview funnel experiment)
- onboarding: ramp-day median -12 days for infra hires (cohort 3 vs cohort 1/2)
- direct feedback: 6x Slack mentions from Eng managers thanking People Ops for onboarding doc (copied into #eng-ops)
- development: peer feedback shows improved coaching score; direct reports report clarity on priorities (pulse survey +0.4)

Development gaps (what I want manager help on):
- exposure: need 1–2 high-visibility ops/partnering projects where I lead stakeholder updates to execs
- strategic narrative: want help shaping a crisp 1-slide story for why small process changes (onboarding + funnel) compound across the product lifecycle
- people leadership: practice having calibration conversations end-to-end (I feel ok in evidence collation, less confident in tone/phrasing when stakes are promotion decisions)

Ask bank (be explicit; pull only a few in each 1:1):
- 1:1: 20m for role-play calibration conversation (mock deliverable + coach) — propose next Wed
- Introduce me to Sam (VP Platform) for a 30m sync to pitch rollout for caching/batching pilot
- Approve $2k budget for external facilitator for inclusive interviewing training (target Q2 cohort)
- Advocate: can you flag my name to Hiring Committee for liaison role on interview rubric refresh?

Open questions / unresolved:
- promotion timeline: want clarity on when we can submit evidence for IC3->IC4 (I think Q3 cadence?)
- comp: L3 compression concern — who can I ask for a comp plan walkthrough? (HR lead?)

Risks / blockers:
- bandwidth: running onboarding pilot + interview funnel + ad-hoc ops support creates risk of slippage on the caching pilot; may need to de-prioritize one project
- dependencies: caching pilot blocked on Platform Eng infra slot (need a champion)

Concrete asks for next 1:1 (pick 2):
- 20m role-play (calibration conversation)
- 10m decision on facilitator budget
- 5m yes/no on intro to VP Platform

Quick evidence snippets to paste into promotion packet (raw):
- "Reduced median TTO from 21d->14d across SWE interviews; candidate drop-off on take-home reduced from 22%->9% over 3 months (JIRA-OPS-211)."
- "Led emergency rollback coordination for serving runtime release; prevented customer-facing outage and documented rollback playbook now used in Release Eng runbook."
- "Onboarding checklist pilot: infra hires ramp median -12 days; direct report Samira shipped infra-healthcheck on day 7."

Mini TODO list (scratch):
- [ ] Draft 1-slide narrative for comp/promotion discussion (due before next 1:1)
- [ ] Send calendar invite for role-play practice
- [ ] Pull pulse survey verbatims related to coaching (Lina to help)
- [ ] Prepare anonymized candidate NPS quotes for hiring committee

Notes-to-self: phrasing examples for calibration: keep it evidence-first, then behavior link, then development ask. Avoid absolutes. Use: "evidence shows", "observed behavior", "recommended next step".

Random scratch: consider running a small internal async workshop about "writing evidence-based calibration notes" — 30m lightning session. Could be low-cost, high-lift. Lina volunteered to help run.

End of doc — capture this as the working backlog. Trim before packaging into promotion packet; migrate 3 strongest evidence items into explicit bullet form when ready.
